releases.notes:
While testing and collecting players feedback, we noticed some critical issues that we decided to fix before focusing on 0.7.0

### Mods Compatibility
- Xaero's world map compatibility fix (by UrBoiTom)
- 1.21-26.3 Flashback compatibility fix (by Weever)

## Fixes
- 1.21.2+ Fix:  Heads disappearing on VR player models after spectating  (by Weever)
- 1.21.11+ Fix: Client crash on swing sweep attack packet handling
- Fix: Server tps minor lags caused failed roomScale consume
- Fix: Overlay dragging in pose settings and demo overlay edge case issues
- Fixes: RoomScale immersion features (sneaking, crawling, climbing etc). Now they are more stable and don't conflict between each other.

## Improvements
-  Screenshot feature was using eye display only. Now it is mixed. When Desktop mirror is displayed - screenshot use it.  Eye display is a fallback.
- Added auto-sprint toggleable option and sprint action binding
- Visor logo in main menu 

### Mods Compatibility
- 1.21.5+ Iris no longer makes crosshair invisible
- Nvidium fixes (by Weever)

## Fixes
- Fix: crash when trying to add more device providers through addon for  FBT, Hand tracking, Body Tracking, Treadmill (by LPlusBonk, new contributor)
- Fix: 26.3 GLX error on Linux (Wayland)
- Fix: 26.1 Crash when swing mining
- Fix: 26.1 Drifted rendering of some mc parts per VR eye

releases.notes:
## Visor got a new Icon
Visor is a platform and its old icon wasn't really good fit. So, Lorex, our artist, made a proper icon for Visor! Simple, recognizable, platform-like. I hope you like it!

## Changes

### Visor Lifecycle update
- Annoying kick from the world fixed. Now Visor kicks you only if VR turned off/disconnected.
- Simplified VRPlayMode states. Removed ALWAYS_ACTIVE, it is too vague and no longer meaningful
### No more Confusing ID
- Player no longer need to specify ID when creating overlay, preset or key input action
### Render scale with Lancoz scaling filter
VR Image quality now can be improved  in rendering settings

## Fixes
- Fix: on newer versions "right clicking" didn't work correctly in some cases
- Fix: crash on newer versions when click "Setup Addons"
- Fix: crash on newer versions when farm-swinging
- 1.21.9+ Fix: scrolling down didn't properly work

# Visor 0.6.0 ALPHA 3:


## Minecraft versions support

**26.1 - 26.3** (Fabric/Forge/NeoForge) are now officially supported!


## Mods compatibility

- Voxy added compatibility (By Weever)
- DistantHorizons compatibility fixes (By Weever)
- Iris compatibility fixes (only thing left is to fix no-crosshair on 1.21.5+. By Weever) 
- Reacharound compatibility fixes (By Sypex)

## Improvements
- Spear item now properly positioned and animated on VR hand
- SteamFrame controllers direct support
- SteamFrame standalone support (Linux arm64)

## API

More mcversion classes, helpful if you want to create your own multi-version addon with stonecutter

releases.notes:
## Minecraft versions support

**1.21.2 - 1.21.11** (Fabric/Forge/NeoForge) are now officially supported!

Warning! Spear and some other new vanilla features  are not yet supported, my main focus atm is to just port Visor with good architecture basis. Spear isn't quick to make, so, wait for later versions.

## Mods compatibility
- This update should have improved compatibility with mods in general, because of changed approach to modifying mc logic
- Sable & Create & Aeronautics fixes and improvements (primarily tested on 1.21.1. Added By timtaran)
- Aeroworks (Aeronautics addon) added compatibility  (primarily tested on 1.21.1. Added By timtaran)
- ReachAround added compatibility (convenient mod for VR, try it. Added By Sypex) 

## API

More mcversion classes, helpful if you want to create your own multi-version addon with stonecutter

## Fixes
- Fix: GL rendering errors that come from other mods no longer cause crash on Visor side
- Fix: Nametag wasn't vanilla in Non-VR mode
- Fix: Networking crash issue on fabric from 1.20.6
